reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: § 8.2 provides successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals, a Customer-only opt-out on thirty days' notice, and a Vendor reminder sixty days before renewal with an extended opt-out deadline if the reminder is missed.
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, satisfying the preferred pricing parameter.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the deterministic notice-window check confirms 30 days ≤ 60.
The rationale correctly distinguishes the three-year initial term in § 8.1 from an automatic multi-year renewal, so the walk-away parameter is not triggered.
